verdicts.reason: A breaks up the design: the green circle is cut off at the left edge and sits far from the can, which has drifted to the right. The CTA has shrunk to a pill the same size as the badges, and it is jammed on the left with tiny, cramped body copy beside it, so the action is buried. B stretches the circle into a distorted ellipse that runs behind the whole banner, the can is tiny and crammed at the left edge, and the body copy is hard to read. Even so, B reads left to right from brand to headline to badges, and it ends on a CTA that clearly stands out, so its hierarchy is better.
